services_heading: Complete Tree Surgery Services Across Newcastle

services.title: Tree Felling & Removal
services.desc: Safe, controlled removal of large or dangerous trees. We dismantle and dispose of everything, leaving your garden clear and level.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Shaping
services.desc: Reduce overgrown canopies to improve light and air, reduce wind risk, and frame your garden. Precise cuts encourage healthy regrowth.

services.title: Deadwood Removal
services.desc: Remove dead and diseased branches that pose a falling hazard. Improves tree health and prevents damage to nearby property.

services.title: Storm Damage & Emergency Response
services.desc: Fallen trees or broken limbs threatening your home? We attend urgently to secure the area and restore safety.

services.title: Stump Grinding & Removal
services.desc: Grind stumps below ground level for a clean finish, or extract roots completely. Reclaim usable garden space.

services.title: Tree Planting & Aftercare
services.desc: Select and plant new specimens suited to your soil and climate. We advise on spacing, species, and long-term maintenance.

about_pullquote: Every tree tells a story. We treat each one with the skill and respect it deserves.
about_para_1: SureTree Limited has been serving Newcastle and the Tyne Valley for over 15 years, built on a foundation of genuine arboricultural expertise and safety-first practise. We started because we saw too many tree surgeons cut corners—leaving clients with botched jobs and dead trees. Today we're proud to have completed over 500 projects, from back-garden fruit trees to mature oaks in listed estates.
about_para_2: Our reputation rests on three principles: honest diagnosis (not every tree needs felling), precise craftsmanship, and meticulous site cleanup. We're fully insured, council-approved for public works, and hold valid certifications. Repeat customers and personal referrals make up the bulk of our work—a sign that people trust us to do the job right the first time.

reviews.text: Had three massive conifers looming over the house causing damp. SureTree came and assessed properly—said two could be reduced, one had to come down. Professional from quote to final cleanup. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Storm brought a 60ft ash tree down across the driveway. Called at 8am, they were here by 10:30. Cleared the whole lot, removed the stump, and we could use the drive again by evening. Brilliant outfit.
reviews.author: Catherine H.

reviews.text: Wanted our overgrown sycamore shaped without killing it. These lads know their stuff—tree looks beautiful now, light floods in, and they explained exactly what they'd done and why. Fair price, zero mess left behind.
reviews.author: David P.
